children: Poland’s corporate employment fell by 0.8% year-on-year to 6.368 million in August 2026, matching market expectations and the pace of decline recorded in July.
This was the 35th consecutive month of decline in employment, underscoring continued weakness in corporate hiring.
On a monthly basis, employment edged down by 0.2%.
In the first eight months of the year, average paid employment dropped by 1.0% to 6.384 million.

title: Poland Employment Falls as Expected
